title: How OOP is used in the AeroTopo project
answer: AeroTopo uses OOP directly in its domain and learning components. The `Product` abstraction encapsulates shared product state and behavior; `Orthomosaic` and `Dem` inherit common rules and override resolution behavior; interfaces such as `Exportable` define contracts; immutable copied collections provide composition; factories centralize creation; records model immutable data; and polymorphism lets common code work through shared types. These choices reduce duplicated logic and keep domain-specific behavior close to the data and invariants it governs.
